description: This file is a client-side JavaScript script for a Frappe framework form called 'Products Settings'. It defines behavior for refreshing the form, specifically updating filter fields related to the 'Item' doctype by adjusting the properties of grid fields dynamically.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles the refresh event of the 'Products Settings' form. Loads metadata for the 'Item' doctype and updates filter fields in the form grid to be of type 'Select' with options derived from relevant 'Item' fields (Link or Table MultiSelect) that are not hidden.
